prompt:
I keep seeing coverage reports show 80% line coverage but we still have bugs in production. Can you explain what line coverage actually measures and what its limitations are? I want to understand why high coverage doesn't guarantee bug-free code.

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The reply explains what line coverage measures.
The reply explains the limitations of line coverage.
The reply explains why high coverage does not guarantee bug-free code.
The reply stays focused on line coverage and does not drift into unrelated topics.
The reply does not include unrequested elements such as scoring schemes, long reports, or formal deliverables.
